subject.title: Memory MVP: implement source attribution and provenance model

question: What native durable-memory provenance contract should OpenClaw use across memory-core storage, short-term promotion, retrieval, and review/edit flows?
rationale: The source-level gap is clear, but source authority, schema shape, merge/edit semantics, and cross-plugin ownership require maintainer product direction before implementation.

options.title: Define Shared Provenance Contract
options.body: Keep this issue as the canonical tracker and specify structured source refs, lineage, and source-required promotion before coding.

options.title: Settle Schema First
options.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/42646 to decide the canonical record and revision model first, then layer provenance onto that schema.

options.title: Keep Provenance Wiki-Only For Now
options.body: Treat Memory Wiki as the provenance-rich optional layer while leaving active memory promotion and retrieval contracts unchanged for now.

recommendation.title: Define Shared Provenance Contract
recommendation.body: Keep this issue as the canonical tracker and specify structured source refs, lineage, and source-required promotion before coding.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent current-main memory schema, citation, promotion, and Memory Wiki history makes vincentkoc the strongest available routing candidate for the cross-memory contract decision.
